BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; HIV/AIDS SUPPORT SERVICES. +]

[+$9,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for grants to community-based HIV/AIDS support services providers. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2027. The base for this appropriation is $9,000,000 in fiscal year 2028. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for HIV/AIDS support services.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; HIV/AIDS SUPPORT SERVICES.

$9,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for grants to community-based HIV/AIDS support services providers. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2027. The base for this appropriation is $9,000,000 in fiscal year 2028.
additions: $9,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for grants to community-based HIV/AIDS support services providers. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2027. The base for this appropriation is $9,000,000 in fiscal year 2028.
